title: DAST: Difficulty-Adaptive Slow-Thinking for Large Reasoning Models
authors_zh: Yi Shen、Jian Zhang、Jieyun Huang、Shuming Shi、Wenjing Zhang、Jiangze Yan、Ning Wang、Kai Wang、Zhaoxiang Liu、Shiguo Lian
paper_type_zh: 难度自适应推理偏好数据构造与 SimPO 训练配方
best_for_zh: 关注 self-rollout、长度预算、偏好对构造与测试时推理计算分配的读者
one_line: DAST samples 20 self-rollouts per MATH question, uses correctness and a difficulty-conditioned token budget to rank candidates, and trains SimPO on the resulting preference pairs.
DAST 对每个 MATH 训练题收集 20 条自生成推理响应，以正确性和难度相关的 Token Length Budget 校准奖励、构造偏好对，并用 SimPO 训练长度自适应的慢思考行为。
why: It makes the rollout budget, token-budget construction, reward-shaped pair ranking, and length-sensitive preference optimization visible, while leaving the reusable records and checker implementation unavailable.
inclusion_reason: DAST is a directly relevant rollout-to-preference recipe that converts multiple self-generated reasoning traces into difficulty-conditioned ranked pairs for efficient test-time reasoning behavior.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Slow-thinking models can spend redundant tokens on easy questions, yet a uniform reduction in reasoning length can also damage harder questions that need extended work. DAST studies how to turn this difficulty–length trade-off into an auditable training object rather than applying one global token policy.

The paper uses MATH training questions and model-generated reasoning responses to build preference data whose ranking signal considers both final-answer correctness and an instance-specific token-length target. The central track-relevant gap is therefore not merely inference efficiency: it is the construction of rollout-derived traces, feedback, and pairs for difficulty-adaptive reasoning.

慢思考模型可能在简单问题上花费冗余 token；但统一缩短推理长度也可能损害需要长推理的困难问题。DAST 研究如何把这种“难度—长度”权衡转化为可审计的训练对象，而非采用单一的全局 token 策略。

论文使用 MATH 训练集问题及模型生成的推理响应，构造偏好数据；其排序信号同时考虑最终答案正确性和样本特定的 token 长度目标。因此，本条目与本 Track 的相关缺口不仅是推理效率，更是为难度自适应推理构造由 rollout 派生的轨迹、反馈与偏好对。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
DAST derives a Token Length Budget (TLB) from rollout statistics for each question. Sampling accuracy and the mean length of correct responses determine how much reasoning length the method treats as appropriate: lower observed accuracy moves the budget toward the maximum generation length.

Each sampled response receives a rule-based reward calibrated by its correctness class and relative deviation from that TLB. The resulting ranked response pool is converted into same-correctness preference pairs, then used by SimPO to learn concise reasoning where the problem appears easy and longer reasoning where the rollout evidence indicates difficulty.

DAST 从每个问题的 rollout 统计量导出 Token Length Budget（TLB）。采样正确率和正确响应的平均长度共同决定方法认为合适的推理长度：观测到的正确率越低，预算越趋近最大生成长度。

每条采样响应都会获得规则式奖励，该奖励由正确性类别及其相对 TLB 的长度偏差共同校准。随后，将排序后的响应池转换为同一正确性类别内的偏好对，并由 SimPO 学习：当问题看起来较容易时更简洁，而当 rollout 证据表明问题困难时保留更长的推理。

title: Method
方法
html:
For every MATH training question, the respective backbone—DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B (DS-7B) or DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B (DS-32B)—collects 20 candidate self-rollouts, each capped at 4,096 tokens. The paper computes TLB as a mixture of the mean correct-response length and the maximum generation length, weighted by sampling accuracy. It then calibrates a rule-based correct/incorrect reward using the response's relative length deviation from TLB, ranks candidates, and writes winner/loser pairs.

The retained pair types are dual-correct pairs (DCP), which compare two correct responses and favor the more concise one, and dual-incorrect pairs (DICP), which compare two incorrect responses and favor the longer reasoning chain when it is within budget. For each question, the maximal-margin DCP and DICP are selected, the bottom margin fraction is removed, and at most one pair of each type is retained. The reported margin-drop fraction is 0.18 for DS-7B and 0.15 for DS-32B.

The resulting datasets contain 10,295 DS-7B pairs and 9,813 DS-32B pairs. The paper reports one epoch of SimPO with AdamW at learning rate 5e-6, beta 200, and gamma 1. Preference-data rollout construction is distinct from evaluation: the latter uses greedy decoding with a 32,768-token generation limit. Sampling temperature, seed, prompt template, exact answer extraction, and correctness-checker implementation are undisclosed.

对每个 MATH 训练集问题，相应的骨干模型 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B（DS-7B）或 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B（DS-32B）收集 20 条候选自 rollout，每条上限为 4,096 token。论文把 TLB 计算为“正确响应平均长度”和“最大生成长度”的混合，并用采样正确率作为权重；之后根据响应相对 TLB 的长度偏差校准规则式正确/错误奖励，对候选排序并写成胜者/败者对。

保留的对包括双正确对（DCP）：比较两条正确响应并偏好更简洁者；以及双错误对（DICP）：比较两条错误响应，并在其未超出预算时偏好推理链更长者。每个问题选取间隔最大的 DCP 与 DICP，删除底部间隔分位中的样本，并且每类至多保留一对。论文报告的间隔删除比例为 DS-7B 的 0.18 和 DS-32B 的 0.15。

最终数据集包含 10,295 个 DS-7B 对和 9,813 个 DS-32B 对。论文报告以学习率 5e-6 的 AdamW 训练 SimPO 一个 epoch，beta 为 200、gamma 为 1。偏好数据 rollout 构造与评测不同：后者采用贪心解码，最大生成长度为 32,768 token。采样温度、随机种子、提示模板、精确答案抽取方式和正确性检查器实现均未披露。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official ACL publication verifies the 2025 EMNLP Industry Track paper, its authors, DOI, and the reported construction recipe. Its method section supports the 20-rollout, 4,096-token construction setting; TLB-based reward calibration; DCP/DICP filtering; and SimPO training configuration. The arXiv record also reports that the authors observed average token-use reduction of over 30% while preserving accuracy on complex problems; this is a reported experimental result, not an independently reproduced finding.

The paper-linked GitHub repository is a verified public artifact, but the inspected README and file tree provide evaluation instructions and model-access directions rather than the documented data-construction pipeline. No official public link was identified for the retained preference pairs, all candidate rollouts/trace logs, pair identifiers, reward/checker implementation, or full SimPO training code.

官方 ACL 论文集记录验证了这篇 2025 年 EMNLP Industry Track 论文、其作者、DOI 及所报告的构造配方。方法部分支持 20 条 rollout、4,096 token 的构造设定、基于 TLB 的奖励校准、DCP/DICP 筛选和 SimPO 训练配置。arXiv 记录还报告作者观察到平均 token 使用量减少超过 30%，同时保持困难问题上的准确性；这是论文报告的实验结果，并非独立复现结果。

论文关联的 GitHub 仓库是已验证的公开工件，但检查到的 README 和文件树提供的是评测说明和模型访问指引，而非论文所述的数据构造流水线。未识别到以下内容的官方公开链接：保留的偏好对、全部候选 rollout/轨迹日志、配对标识、奖励/检查器实现，或完整的 SimPO 训练代码。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The distinctive data-construction move is not simply to select correct rollouts. DAST uses repeated self-rollouts to estimate per-question difficulty, turns that estimate into a target length, and ranks responses with a feedback signal that couples correctness with length relative to the target.

It further separates two same-correctness learning signals: concise-vs-concise DCP selection for correct answers and longer-within-budget DICP selection for incorrect answers. This makes the data object a length-sensitive preference recipe, with the important caveat that the complete underlying traces and pair records are not released.

其有别于单纯筛选正确 rollout 的数据构造动作是：DAST 利用重复的自 rollout 估计每个问题的难度，把该估计转化为目标长度，并以“正确性 + 相对目标长度”的反馈信号对响应排序。

它还拆分了两种同正确性类别内的学习信号：对正确答案，以 DCP 选择更简洁者；对错误答案，以 DICP 选择在预算内推理更长者。这使得数据对象成为对长度敏感的偏好学习配方；但完整的底层轨迹和配对记录并未发布。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
DAST is only partially reusable. The publication specifies aggregate counts and much of the recipe, but does not disclose the 20-rollout records, retained/rejected pair identities, full preference datasets, or their licenses. The paper also leaves the sampling temperature, seeds, prompt format, answer extraction, correctness checker, checker error behavior, decontamination procedure, and immutable data/model revision unknown.

The rule-based reward depends on a truncation-sensitive length budget. The authors note threshold sensitivity, STEM-only evaluation, and constraints from off-policy preference learning; they also warn that low-discriminability long DICP pairs can create reward-hacking risk. The linked repository should not be treated as a verified release of the construction code, trace corpus, or training data.

DAST 只能部分复用。论文披露了汇总数量和配方中的大部分步骤，但未披露 20 条 rollout 的记录、保留/拒绝对的标识、完整偏好数据集及其许可证。论文同样未披露采样温度、随机种子、提示格式、答案抽取、正确性检查器、检查器错误行为、去污染流程以及不可变的数据/模型版本，均应记为 unknown。

该规则式奖励依赖对截断敏感的长度预算。作者指出阈值敏感性、仅在 STEM 范围评测以及离线偏好学习的约束；他们还警示低可区分度的长 DICP 对可能带来奖励黑客风险。关联仓库不应被视为已验证的构造代码、轨迹语料或训练数据发布。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For post-training research, DAST is a concrete audit target for converting a fixed rollout budget into pairwise supervision. It exposes the prompt source, rollout count, response cap, reward ingredients, pair taxonomy, filtering scheme, retained counts, and SimPO hyperparameters—enough to analyze the intended feedback contract.

For test-time-compute work, it illustrates a preference-learning route to difficulty-dependent response length rather than an online search controller. For data reuse or benchmarking, it should be treated as a documented recipe and result claim, not as an available trace dataset: reproductions need to rebuild the rollout collection and checker and should report the currently unknown settings.

对后训练研究而言，DAST 是将固定 rollout 预算转换为成对监督的具体审计对象。它公开了提示来源、rollout 数、响应上限、奖励组成、配对分类、筛选方案、保留数量和 SimPO 超参数，足以分析其意图中的反馈契约。

对测试时计算研究而言，它说明了一条通过偏好学习获得难度依赖响应长度的路径，而不是在线搜索控制器。对数据复用或基准研究而言，应把它视作已文档化的配方和结果声明，而非可获得的轨迹数据集：复现者需要自行重建 rollout 收集与检查器，并报告目前未知的设定。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Section 2 together: verify how sampling accuracy, correct-response length, and maximum length enter TLB before interpreting the calibrated reward.
  • In Section 2.3, distinguish DCP from DICP and note that correct-vs-incorrect pairs were reported as unhelpful; inspect the margin filtering and one-pair-per-class constraint.
  • Cross-check Section 3.1/Table 1 and the Limitations section against the linked repository; do not assume that its evaluation utilities release the 20-rollout corpus, preference pairs, or checker.

• 请连贯阅读第 2 节：在解释校准奖励之前，先核对采样正确率、正确响应长度和最大长度如何进入 TLB。
  • 阅读第 2.3 节时，区分 DCP 和 DICP，并注意论文报告“正确—错误”对没有帮助；检查间隔筛选和每类每题至多一对的约束。
  • 将第 3.1 节/表 1 与 Limitations 及关联仓库交叉核对；不要假定其中的评测工具发布了 20 条 rollout 语料、偏好对或检查器。
